dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge exhibiting a smooth parabolic curve from the posterior base to the sub-terminal apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a medium pixel radius, classified as obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderate ascending slope, approximately 40 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-profile convex arc extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak profile with limited horizontal extension from the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse inflection point where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant notch present on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin just below the apex; irregular depigmented white patch on the lateral head region.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniformly dark, near-black pigmentation across all visible surfaces.
